title: helianthemum grandiflorum subsp. glabrum
intro: Helianthemum grandiflorum subsp. glabrum, commonly known as rockrose, is a plant species belonging to the Cistaceae family. It has been used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits, including anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties, which help to soothe wounds, reduce inflammation, and protect against oxidative stress. The therapeutic actions of rockrose include analgesic, antispasmodic, and hemostatic effects, making it useful for treating pain, muscle spasms, and bleeding. The bioactive constituents of rockrose include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties and have been shown to possess potential anti-cancer and cardiovascular-protective effects.
